description: Open a recording file (.kfrec.json) made on a device (Motion Scan record button) or saved from the panel. It becomes the recording every other tool reads; returns its report. A recording from a build without Metro (an internal preview build) has raw stacks: pass that build's source map to map them to source lines.

sourceMap.description: The .map file of the bundle the recording's build embeds, for recordings from preview builds.

name: open_recording
